private_lines.Lene: You work as a freelance translator from a small flat in Vesterbro, mostly translating documents and business texts for clients around Europe. You live alone, and your days are quiet, with long stretches at your desk and a walk in the afternoon before the evening.
private_lines.Svend: You are retired and spend part of each week as a volunteer at the local library in Frederiksberg, where you shelve books and help people with the computers. You live alone in a flat in Nørrebro, and your days are steady, with a morning walk, library shifts, and a quiet evening at home.
private_lines.Freja: You are a university student in Copenhagen, studying part-time while you live with flatmates in Østerbro, and your days are a mix of lectures, reading in the library, and evenings with friends. You share the flat with other students who are not in this chat, and your routine shifts from day to day.
private_lines.Niels: You teach history at a secondary school in Copenhagen, which keeps you busy with lessons, marking, and preparing for class. You live with Susanne in Frederiksberg, and your days are full on school days, with quieter evenings at home and weekends spent around the house.
private_lines.Susanne: You work as a municipal planner at the city hall in Copenhagen, reviewing building and zoning proposals and meeting with colleagues. You live with Niels in Frederiksberg, and your days follow a regular office rhythm, with evenings spent at home and occasional time with the choir.
